name: Mama Sis ~Okaa-san to Watashi, Docchi ga Ii no?~
original_name: まましす 〜お母さんとわたし、どっちがいいの?〜
source:
The hero's father owns an inn named YAYOI. His mother has died ten years prior. Mirei Yasoshima, a friend of the hero's father comes over to take care of the hero. Sometimes she will bring her two daughters with her, and the group has fun together as he grows up. One day, someone wonders who is a better lover: Mirei or one of her daughters. They ask the hero to help decide. 
[Summarized from Getchu]
translation:
主人公的父亲经营着一家名叫YAYOI的旅馆，母亲则在10年前去世。父亲的朋友八十岛美玲会过来照顾主人公，有时也会带上自己的两个女儿。他就在与她们一同玩乐的时光中逐渐长大。一天，有人好奇，美玲与她的女儿们，究竟谁更适合做恋人，于是请主人公帮忙作出判断。
[根据Getchu简介概述]
